hrCommon.readFailed: Could not load this list. Try again, or ask Admin if it keeps happening.
hrCommon.sodNext: Ask another person with the right to do this step.
hrCommon.noRight: You don't have the right to change this. Ask Admin.
hrCommon.readOnly: Read-only view: you can see this but not change it.

rules.staff.name: Enter the full name as on the ID.
rules.staff.designation: Every staff member needs a designation.
rules.staff.pay_company: Choose the company that issues the payslip.
rules.staff.aadhaar: Enter the 12-digit Aadhaar or its last 4 digits. Only the last 4 are kept.
rules.staff.request: Only an approved advance request of this person can be paid.
rules.staff.request_paid: This advance request is already paid.
rules.staff.request_missing: This request was not found. Reload the list.
rules.payroll.month_locked: Payroll for this month is already approved, so it is locked.
rules.cash.payment_over_limit: Cash over the daily limit to one person needs a reason Admin will see — or pay by bank.
rules.cash.limits_not_set: The cash limits are not set yet. Admin sets them on Settings.
rules.posting.rule_missing: A posting rule is missing for this company. Set it on Bank → Set-up:
rules.posting.unbalanced: The entry does not balance. Nothing was posted.
rules.period.no_fy: There is no open financial year for this date. Open it on Numbering.
rules.period.closed: This month is closed in the books.
rules.entries.backdate: This date is older than allowed. Ask Admin for a “Back-date entries” permission.
rules.date.future: The date cannot be in the future.
